United Natural Foods (UNFI) is a Providence, Rhode Island wholesale distributor of natural, organic and conventional food, listed on the New York Stock Exchange (UNFI). Wow! Momo is a Kolkata based Indian fast-food chain specialising in momos (dumplings) and related items, run through hundreds of company-owned and franchise outlets in cities across India. Halwani Bros is a Saudi food manufacturer based in Jeddah, producing halawa, tahini, spreads, jams, ready meals, bakery and other packaged foods, supplied across Saudi Arabia and the Middle East. Lifeway Foods is a US maker of kefir, a cultured dairy drink, along with cheeses, probiotic drinks and frozen kefir, based in Morton Grove, Illinois. Fast-growing consumer brand skewed to younger urban customers; strong US visibility.

Genki Forest is a Chinese beverage company launched in 2016, known for sugar-free sparkling water, particularly with flavours, and for tea and milk tea products. It is headquartered in Beijing and backed by Sequoia China, HillHouse and Tiger Global, valued at about 6 billion dollars in 2021. Strong young-consumer brand in China, with sponsorship of sport and esports events.

Junlebao Dairy (Shijiazhuang Junlebao Dairy) is a Chinese dairy producer from Hebei province, best known for its Junlebao infant formula, liquid milk and yogurt products. Founded in 1993 and headquartered in Shijiazhuang, it was among the infant formula brands that rebuilt after the 2008 melamine scandal (a Sanlu affiliate in the same city), and it later raised funding from investors including CITIC and Taikang, and was planning a Hong Kong listing. Consumer food brand with solid regional recognition in China.
